definitions.short: a prophetess or (generally) inspired woman; by implication, a poetess ; by association a prophet's wife
definitions.full: H5031. nebiah נְבִיאָה noun masculine prophetess ; — 1. a. of the ancient type endowed with gift of song, Miriam Exod 15:20 ; Deborah Judg 4:4 . b. of the later type consulted for a word of ׳י , Huldah 2Kin 22:14 2Chr 34:22 . 2 false prophetess, Noadiah Neh 6:14 . 3 wife of Isaiah Isa 8:3 .
